kebab_example: aliyun ros list-stacks --page-size 10 --parent-stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --show-nested-stack true --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --status CREATE_COMPLETE --stack-name MyStack --tag Value=test Key=usage --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --stack-ids 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --start-time 2023-04-01T15:10:00Z --end-time 2023-04-01T15:16:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStacks

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page when paging is used.  

Maximum value: 50.
  
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。  

最大值：50。
  
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent stack
parameters.name: parent_stack_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the stack list.  

Start value: 1.
  
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈列表的页码。  

起始值：1。
  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to list nested stacks. Valid values:

true
false (default)
  
If ParentStackId is specified, this value is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否列出嵌套资源栈。取值：

true
false（默认值）
  
如果指定了ParentStackId，则该值为true。
parameters.name: show_nested_stack

parameters.help_en: The stack ID. If you do not need detailed stack information, you can specify this parameter instead of calling the GetStack operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈ID。如果不需要资源栈详细信息，可以指定此参数，代替GetStack接口
parameters.name: stack_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the stack.  
Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
资源栈的标签键。  
N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the stack.  
Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
资源栈的标签值。  
N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.  
For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。  
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range for filtering by creation time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 按创建时间查询，创建时间区间的起始点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range for filtering by creation time. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 按创建时间查询，创建时间区间的终止点。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the stack list

PageSize.description_en:
The number of entries per page in paging Settings.  

Maximum value: 50.
  
Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。  

最大值：50。
  
默认值：10

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the stack was created. The time is displayed in UTC+0 in the ISO 8601 standard format without the Z suffix. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间，但缺少Z结尾，格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled for the stack. Valid values:
Enabled: Deletion protection is enabled.
Disabled: Deletion protection is disabled. You can delete the stack by using the console or by calling the [DeleteStack]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610812.html） operation.

The deletion protection mechanism of a nested stack is the same as that of the root stack
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否开启资源栈删除保护。取值：
Enabled：开启资源栈删除保护。
Disabled：关闭资源栈删除保护。此时支持通过控制台或[DeleteStack]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610812.html）接口释放资源栈。

嵌套资源栈的删除保护机制与根资源栈一致

DisableRollback.description_en:
Indicates whether rollback is disabled when the stack fails to be created. Valid values:

true: Rollback is disabled.
false (default): Rollback is enabled
DisableRollback.description_zh:
当创建资源栈失败时，是否禁用回滚策略。取值：

true：禁用回滚，即当创建资源栈失败时不进行回滚。
false（默认值）：不禁用回滚，即当创建资源栈失败时进行回滚

DriftDetectionTime.description_en: The time when the most recent successful drift detection was performed on the stack
DriftDetectionTime.description_zh: 资源栈最近一次成功的偏差检测的时间

OperationInfo.description_en:
The supplementary information that is returned when an error occurs during a stack operation.

This response property is returned only in specific cases and contains at least one sub-property. For example, an error occurs when another cloud service API is called
OperationInfo.description_zh:
资源栈操作发生错误时的补充信息。

该返回属性仅在特定情况下返回，且至少返回一个子属性。例如：调用其他云服务API报错

Action.description_en: The name of the API operation called on another cloud service
Action.description_zh: 调用其他云服务API的名称

Code.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

Forbidden.RAM: Access denied by RAM.
InvalidAccountStatus.NotEnoughBalance: Insufficient account balance.
OrderError.EIP: EIP order error.
QuotaExceeded.Eip: EIP quota exceeded.

This information is generated based on call logs and may be incomplete. Verify the information
Code.description_zh:
错误码。取值：

Forbidden.RAM：RAM权限禁止。
InvalidAccountStatus.NotEnoughBalance：账户余额不足。
OrderError.EIP：EIP订单错误。
QuotaExceeded.Eip：EIP配额超出。

该信息依据调用日志生成，可能存在不完善情况，请检查

LogicalResourceId.description_en: The logical ID of the resource on which the operation error occurred
LogicalResourceId.description_zh: 发生操作错误的资源逻辑ID

Message.example: There is still instance(s) in the specified security group.

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the API call to another cloud service
RequestId.description_zh: 调用其他云服务API的请求ID

ResourceType.description_en: The resource type on which the operation error occurred
ResourceType.description_zh: 发生操作错误的资源类型

ParentStackId.description_en: The ID of the parent stack

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html） to query the most recent region list
RegionId.description_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html）查看最新的阿里云地域列表

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the stack is a managed stack. Valid values:  

true: The stack is a managed stack.  

false: The stack is not a managed stack
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管资源栈。取值：  

true：是托管资源栈。  

false：不是托管资源栈

ServiceName.description_en: The service name to which the managed stack belongs
ServiceName.description_zh: 托管资源栈所属的服务名称

StackDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the stack in the most recent successful drift detection. Valid values:
DRIFTED: The stack has drifted.
NOT_CHECKED: No successful drift detection has been performed on the stack.
IN_SYNC: The stack is in sync
StackDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源栈最近一次成功的偏差检测中的资源栈状态，取值：
DRIFTED：资源栈处于检测状态。
NOT_CHECKED：资源栈未进行过成功的偏差检测。
IN_SYNC：资源栈处于同步状态

StackType.description_en:
The stack type. Valid values:

ROS: The stack uses an ROS template.
Terraform: The stack uses a Terraform template
StackType.description_zh:
资源栈类型，取值：

ROS：使用ROS模板的资源栈。
Terraform：使用Terraform模板的资源栈

StatusReason.description_en: The reason why the stack is in its current status

Key.description_en: The tag key of the stack

Value.description_en: The tag value of the stack

TimeoutInMinutes.description_en:
The timeout period for creating the stack. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 10, 20, 60, 120, and 1440.

This information is generated based on call logs and may be incomplete. Verify the information
TimeoutInMinutes.description_zh:
创建资源栈的超时时间。单位：分钟。取值范围：10, 20, 60, 120, 1440。

该信息依据调用日志生成，可能存在不完善情况，请检查

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the stack was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC+0 in the ISO 8601 standard format without the Z suffix. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
UpdateTime.description_zh: 资源栈更新时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间，但缺少Z结尾，格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss
